summary: LLMTR is an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway run by Knowhy (Istanbul) offering one API key for hosted and global models. Its model page states Qwen3.8 Max via model id qwen/qwen3.8-max-free is free until 13 November 2026 03:00 Turkey time, and may close earlier if free usage ends sooner. Each account may use 3 million tokens during the period; input, output and cache-read input count together and the allowance does not renew. During peak hours requests may be rejected with HTTP 503; wait for the Retry-After period before retrying. Requests authenticate with an LLMTR API key.
claim_steps: Call the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with model qwen/qwen3.8-max-free before 13 Nov 2026 03:00 Turkey time
